In the 26th minute, disaster struck for the home side when Tiago inadvertently sent the ball into his own net, giving Bahia an early lead. The visitors looked to capitalize on this momentum, but the game became physical, evidenced by a yellow card for Nicolas Acevedo shortly after the half-hour mark. Just before the interval, Coritiba was forced into a change as Leo Vieira made way for Joao Paulo , adding to the tension of a difficult first half. In the first minute of stoppage time, Everaldo pulled one back for the visitors after an assist from Everton Ribeiro , setting up a nervous finish. However, Coritiba held firm through the final moments of added time to secure all three points in a memorable contest.

On May 17, 2026, two of Brazil's most storied clubs took to the field for a highly anticipated Serie A encounter. The match promised a tactical battle and a display of raw emotion as both sides sought to climb the league standings in front of a passionate crowd. Coritiba's First-Half Masterclass Coritiba started the match with incredible intensity, catching the Santos defense off guard within the opening minutes. In the 5th minute, Josue turned provider, setting up Breno Lopes for a clinical finish that gave the visitors an early lead. The momentum stayed firmly with the away side, and by the 20th minute, Breno Lopes found the net again, this time converting an assist from Pedro Rocha to double the advantage and stun the home supporters. As the first half drew to a close, the pressure on Santos became overwhelming. In the 39th minute, following a foul that saw Gonzalo Escobar booked, Coritiba was awarded a penalty. Josue stepped up to the spot and calmly converted, extending the lead to three goals. The hosts struggled to find any rhythm, heading into the break with a significant mountain to climb and visible frustration among the players. Disciplinary Meltdown in the Second Period The second half saw Santos attempt to rotate their squad, bringing on Gabriel Barbosa and later Robinho Junior for Neymar , who had earlier received a yellow card. However, any hopes of a comeback were effectively extinguished in the 73rd minute. Alvaro Barreal , who had entered the game as a substitute at halftime, was shown a straight red card. The decision sparked heavy protests from the Santos players, but the referee remained unmoved, forcing the hosts to play the remainder of the match with ten men. In the final stages, the game became fragmented by fouls and further bookings for Joao Ananias and Gabriel Barbosa . Coritiba professionally managed the closing minutes, utilizing their numerical advantage to see out the game. The final whistle confirmed a comprehensive performance for the visitors, while Santos was left to rue a night where both their defense and their discipline failed them on home soil.
